sourceTitle: The Christmas Story from David Harum
description: "The Christmas Story from David Harum" by Edward Noyes Westcott is a novella adapted from the original novel "David Harum," written in the late 19th century. This heartwarming tale revolves around the character David Harum, known for his generosity and unique, kind-hearted ways, as he assists the destitute Widow Cullom during Christmas.
